explication: LifeOS is an AI-powered personal operating system layered onto an AI coding harness. Its documented setup begins when a user asks their harness to install LifeOS; the installer stages the runtime and user configuration. During use, persistent context, skills, routing, and hooks personalize the harness, while Pulse and its dashboard expose activity and life-system state. The README documents these capabilities, but most runtime source was not sampled, so subsystem connections beyond the install excerpts are shown as unverified rather than asserted.
